output.narrative:
Total revenue decreased by -3.51% (-6.83). The primary metric anomaly occurred in ctr, which drove a revenue decline primarily through requests (-8.7 contribution). 

The movement in ctr was localized to country=DE, with an explanatory power of 1.156 and a lift of 20.13. Within country=DE, the effect was broad-based across device models, with Redmi Note 12 showing a lift of 1.0. 

Other segments, such as ad_format=banner with an explanatory power of -0.145, were checked and ruled out.
